question: At the July 23 NYSE close, what do Coca-Cola's Q2 results imply for its medium-term investment thesis and a holder's action?

evidence.text: Coca-Cola reported second-quarter net operating revenue of USD 12.363 billion, up 3% year over year. Organic revenue, a non-GAAP measure, rose 15% with price/mix up 9% and concentrate sales up 6%. Global unit case volume rose 2%. GAAP operating income rose 10%; GAAP EPS fell 5% to USD 0.56 while comparable non-GAAP EPS rose 7% to USD 0.84.

Management updated full-year 2024 guidance to 9–10% organic revenue growth and 5–6% comparable EPS growth. Both are non-GAAP forecasts. Management expected currency to reduce comparable EPS growth by 8–9 percentage points.
